verdict: Leads are arriving efficiently; none are reaching your pipeline yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 176 leads from Meta at $12.15 per lead — well below the $19–45 range seen in July, so ad efficiency is holding. Lead volume dipped 11% this past week, and your Google Business Profile activity fell sharply, with near-zero local search actions in the last three days of the period. The critical gap right now is downstream: leads are coming in but none are converting into tracked pipeline opportunities, which points to an intake bottleneck rather than an ads problem. We are working to get contact and follow-up automation in place to close that gap before the end of the month.
